reason: The pilot costs us nothing and the desk complaints are real, but I don't see where this brings in more green fees, buggy hire or bar revenue than GOLF.NL plus our current system already do. And I'm not taking a two-founder product to my board before Zwolle has shown it works. Founding-club places are open until July 2027, so I can wait for their results and still get the € 0.49 price.
objection: GOLF.NL is free and members already use it to book and pay. Paying around € 465 to € 618 a month for a nicer app in our own colours has to earn that back in revenue, and nothing here shows me it will. On top of that it is two people, so even with escrow and an export I end up going back to the members' meeting if it falls over.
would_change_my_mind: Zwolle's results page and a call with their board showing hard numbers: more guest bookings, extras and bar spend through the app, and less work at the desk, enough to cover the fee.
